limitations: This record observes only the exact 4caf127 push and the uniquely identified attempt-1 runs at the stated request intervals. The earlier immutable observations remain byte-identical; none is re-dated or transferred to this checkpoint.

The five sequential requests are non-atomic. Run-level queued/null states are preserved exactly even where their job lists include completed jobs; no workflow outcome is synthesized from sibling job results.

Job conclusions and named step statuses are API observations, not independently verified execution or original-report pass evidence. No logs, original controlled-fixture XML, artifacts, distributions, fixture captures or loaded-artifact enrollment were inspected.

Implementation Mac fails first at harness step 6. Planning Windows and Mac fail first at harness step 5. These three failure mechanisms are not diagnosed by metadata, and earlier hosts/checkpoints/log diagnoses or unittest counts are not imported.

Planning Linux, Desktop and Bridges Linux advertise success. Implementation Linux/Windows, Android, iOS and Bridges Mac/Windows are queued with no observed steps. Queue state proves neither success nor failure; no full required-workflow success exists.

This one observation used all five authorized GETs and no pagination, retry, polling loop, workflow control operation, credential/account probe or Git/source edit. The earlier Android 403 acquisition and blocked Windows bridge operation were not retried or routed around.

Original JSON response bytes, private stderr files and the private container remain untouched in an ignored owner-only directory with 0700 directory and 0600 file modes. Only bounded fixed sanitized API fields, response hashes/sizes and request intervals are projected here.

No historical committed-source byte pins were recomputed using Git or current local files. Exact run/job SHA and attempt binding do not bind the actual loaded artifact bytes or unrelated current working-tree changes.

All seven qualification flags remain false. Query/status observations do not constitute verified execution, all-rule, production Native supervision, Apple ABI, native throws, original stress/JUnit artifact, loaded-artifact enrollment or release qualification.
